what: float64 time-dependent second-order operators of deep tanh MLPs u(t, x) = wo . tanh(W_L ... tanh(W_1 (t, x) + b_1) ...) + bo, W_1 of shape (H, 1 + D), at B points (t ~ U(0, 1), x ~ N(0, I / D)): forward = operator values; vg = 0.5 mean (Op u - f)^2 and its gradient w.r.t. every weight, bias and readout parameter. Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.projected_laplacian.projected_deep_laplacian with coordinates = the D space indices, a diagonal diffusion s for aniso_diag and the time or drift direction (1, -x) as a carried first-order direction: the space columns of W_1 are a static slice (scaled by s), projected to k = min(D, H) columns; no (1 + D) x D selection matrix is formed. The cell with D < H is a control where the projection cannot reduce anything; the explicit-selection tier is the same module given the selection matrix (the interface without coordinates); the projected-generic tier feeds the same projected columns to generic engines, isolating the closed-form recursion from the projection; nested autodiff runs where D <= 1024
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's forward and vg programs on a reduced instance (width 4, B = 2, D_q = min(D, 40) > 4 space coordinates so the projection is active, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (second-order Taylor series over (t, x) along every space direction, the time direction and the drift, no projection or selection; objective derivatives along two fixed random parameter directions by central differences in 50 digits): values and objective 1e-9 / 2e-10, directional derivatives 1e-8 / 2e-9 (scaled); full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.explicit_selection: the same module with the (1 + D) x D selection matrix, columns scaled by s for aniso_diag, as the diffusion factor; the interface without coordinates; the matrix is formed inside the program
tiers.forward_laplacian_full_seed: the same recursion seeded with the D space columns of W_1, scaled by s; equal to collapsed Taylor mode for these operators; omnibias.jax.laplacian.deep_field_value_grad_laplacian and folx.forward_laplacian of y -> u(t, s y) at y = x / s, u_t by one forward tangent pass
tiers.taylor_mode: jax.experimental.jet, one second-order jet per space column and one first-order jet for the time or (1, -x) tangent, started at the first pre-activation
tiers.projected_generic: the same projection with generic engines: jet with the k = min(D, H) projected columns F of qrlap_lib.seed_factor, and folx.forward_laplacian of y -> u at z_1 + F y; isolates the closed-form recursion from the projection
tiers.nested_autodiff: jax.hessian over (t, x) and jax.grad per point; D <= 1024

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning
